胡九郎话说到一半，忽然顿住，眼神飘向远方，像是被什么东西勾住了心神。

范梦雪眨着清澈的眼睛，仰头望着他，好奇问道：“但是什么？师兄，你怎么不说了？”

胡九郎轻吸一口气，压下心底那道身影，淡淡一笑，掩饰道：

“没什么，只是觉得，这一切发生得太顺了。”

“太顺了？”

“你师父早早就备好清心草、驱邪花，早早让你下山，还特意交代，正一真炁能助我。杨童前脚刚走，后脚就带着重大线索回来，连黑市的路子都直接送到眼前。整件事，就像有人提前铺好路，一步一步，逼着我们往里走。”

范梦雪脸上的轻松渐渐散去，说道：

“师兄，你是说……师伯、我师父，他们早就知道会这样？还是说……敌人都算到了这一点？”

“我不知道。”

胡九郎摇头，又道：

“玄门中人不轻易窥天命，更不轻易布局。可这次，处处都像布局。师妹，你刚下山，心思纯粹，不懂世间这些弯弯绕绕，你本可以留在山上清净修行，不必跟着我趟这趟浑水。”

范梦雪立刻停下脚步，拉住他的衣袖，小脸上带着一丝倔强，撅起小嘴说道：

“我不！师父让我跟着你，我就跟着你。而且师兄你人这么好，我不能让你一个人冒险。再说了，我可是神逍派弟子，身负正一真炁，就是下山除魔卫道的。影阁这种邪派重现人间，我怎么能躲开？”

胡九郎看着她一脸认真、半点不掺假的模样，心头那点沉闷、那点对杨童的纷乱思绪，忽然被轻轻扫开。

他失笑一声，伸手轻轻敲了下她的额头，笑道：

“你啊，刚下山，一身正气，满身锐气，迟早要吃亏。”

“吃亏也是跟着师兄一起吃。”

范梦雪揉了揉额头，笑眯眯地说道。

胡九郎不再多说，转身继续往前走。

只是他心底，那种莫名的忐忑，依旧挥之不去。

他自己从不给自己占卦，可此刻，却莫名有一种预感。

两人辗转几条老街，越走越偏。

Halfway through his words, Hu Jiulang suddenly paused and his eyes drifted into the distance, as if he was caught by something.

Fan Mengxue blinked her clear eyes, looked up at him, and asked curiously: "But what? Senior brother, why didn't you say anything?"

Hu Jiulang took a breath, suppressed the figure in his heart, smiled faintly, and said:

"It's nothing, I just feel that everything happened so smoothly."

"Too smooth?"

"Your master prepared the Qingxincao and the exorcism flower early, and asked you to go down the mountain early. He also specifically told me that Zhengyi Zhenqi can help me. As soon as Yang Tong left, he came back with important clues. Even the road to the black market was directly presented to us. The whole thing is like someone paving the road in advance, step by step, forcing us to go in."

The relief on Fan Mengxue's face gradually dissipated and she said:

"Senior brother, are you saying that...my uncle and my master, they already knew this would happen? Or...that the enemy had already figured this out?"

"I don't know."

Hu Jiulang shook his head and said:

"People in Xuanmen don't easily peek into destiny, let alone lay it out. But this time, everything looks like a layout. Junior sister, you have just come down from the mountain, your mind is pure, and you don't understand the twists and turns of the world. You could have stayed on the mountain to practice pure and pure, instead of following me through this muddy water."

Fan Mengxue immediately stopped and pulled his sleeves. With a hint of stubbornness on her face, she pursed her lips and said:

"I don't! Master asked me to follow you, so I will follow you. And senior brother, you are such a nice person, I can't let you take risks alone. Besides, I am a disciple of the Shenxiao sect. I have Zhengyi Zhenqi, and I go down the mountain to slay demons and protect the way. How can I avoid the evil sect like Shadow Pavilion when it reappears in the world?"

Hu Jiulang looked at her serious and unadulterated look, and the dullness and chaotic thoughts about Yang Tong in his heart were suddenly gently swept away.

He laughed, reached out and tapped her forehead lightly, and said with a smile:

"You just came down from the mountain, you are full of righteousness and vigor, but sooner or later you will suffer a loss."

"If you suffer a loss, you will suffer with your senior brother."

Fan Mengxue rubbed her forehead and said with a smile.

Hu Jiulang said no more, turned around and continued walking forward.

But deep down in his heart, that inexplicable uneasiness still lingered.

He himself never gave fortune-telling to himself, but at this moment, he had an inexplicable premonition.

The two wandered through several old streets, going further and further off the beaten path.
